page.overview:
Who is Katrina Chloros?

Katrina Chloros was the captain of the Kytherea.

Katrina Chloros was a soldier in the service of House Atreides. She trained Anton Tolliver, who she found to be sweet and naive. She was the captain of the Kytherea when it crash-landed on Arrakis.

Chloros was approached by the Prisoner in Hagga Rift. Near death, she told them to ask her any questions they wished while they still could. She told them that her family had been loyal to the Atreides for all of recorded time, but they lost their status during the War of Assassins. She revealed that Tighe Skorda had tasked her with smuggling cargo on the Kytherea off the record. They were ambushed over Arrakis and went down alongside the Delphis and the Euphoria. The cargo was stolen by bandits and Chloros believed that Skorda had betrayed them, as he was the only person who knew the significance of the containers. She recalls consoling the rest of the crew as they died and contacting her superiors for help, only to receive none. She received a communication from Andrea Ganan, who advised her to abandon the crew due to fear of infection, but she refused. Chloros told the Prisoner to tell Tolliver that she was sorry before they departed.
